x: At Briants Puddle on August 6th, Murray Day won the Bladen 7 with Neil Foster 7th.

Graham Seatter finished off his year back with us turning out when he could and showing Murray Day the ropes. During the year Graham collected two National medals and an Inter Counties team medal, not a bad achievement for someone who had given up walking for the last three years.
At last we had a reasonable turn out and won with Murray Day not scoring, the host club, however, had their three best men absent and they could have given us trouble.

But despite the moans and groans we still won the team, with Murray Day coming to life after a quiet Enfield for 4th place. Individual winner was Phil Vesty, winner two years ago, although not so fast.
Ian McCombie dominated the race from the start and eit was left to Murray Day to come home a distant 2nd. Belgrave backed well to finish 4 in 9 and an easy win.

In the Garnet held in conjunction Murray Day had a comfortable win but Steyning were too strong in the team and we finished 2nd again. 1.M.Easton (S.W.C.) 2.J.Ball (Soton) 71.00; 3.M.Day 72.15; 4.R.Dorman 73.37; 9.C.Lawton 77.55; 10.J.Hall 78.11; 15.P.Warburton 79.00; 16.J.Llewellin 79.15; 19.M.Feig…

A turn out of 22 in the combined event with Surrey and Middlesex Championship in conjunction gave an easy win for Murry Day. 1.M.Day 44.45; 2.A.James (Enf) 45.51; 3.J.Hall 46.53; 4.C.Lawton 47.05; 5.P.Warburton 47.09; 6.R.Tanner 47.17; 9.M.Feighan 50.25; 11.J.Newnham 51.19; 14.D.Fotheringham 52.29;…

Early leader Murray Day fell foul of stomach problems and slipped to a final 3rd place. Belgrave's team was always uncertain with John Llewellyn collecting too many cards, and Carl Lawton slipping out of 4th team place so it was left to Day, Warburton, Tanner and Feighan to collect 2nd team.
In the Inter Counties 3Kms Chris Maddocks 1st 12.24 gained his revenge over Murray Day 12.29 for the track competition defeat.
In a 5 miles at Carshalton Murray Day won in 34.28 to C.Lawton 2nd 36.57; 3rd P.Warburton 37.04; 5th J.Cleave 44.37; 9.J.Morris 48.16.
